fieldValues.title: The `Address` union
fieldValues.content:
`Address`, in pseudo-IDL:

```typescript
type Address =
  | {
      space: "document"
      containerId: UUID
      recordId?: UUID
      fieldId?: UUID
    }
  | {
      space: "process"
      runId: UUID          // Protocol run ID; requires ext:protocol
      stageId?: string
    }
  | {
      space: "conversation"
      sessionId: UUID
      chunkId?: UUID
      annotationId?: UUID
    }
```
